q: With what would the apostles be baptized in a few days?
a: The apostles would be baptized with the Holy Spirit.

q: In what did the baptized people continue?
a: They continued in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread and in prayers.

q: By what power or in what name did Peter say he had healed the man in the Temple?
a: Peter said that in the name of Jesus Christ he had healed the man in the Temple.

q: Why could the Jewish leaders say nothing against Peter and John?
a: The leaders could say nothing because the man who had been healed was standing with Peter and John.

q: To whom did Peter say Ananias and Sapphira had lied?
a: Peter said that Ananias and Sapphira had not lied to men, but to the Holy Spirit.

q: What were some people doing to have the sick healed?
a: Some were carrying the sick into the streets so Peter’s shadow might fall on them, and others brought the sick from other towns to Jerusalem.

q: How did the Sadducees react to all of the sick being healed in Jerusalem?
a: The Sadducees were filled with jealousy and put the apostles in jail.

q: What did Stephen accuse the people of always doing, just as their forefathers had done?
a: Stephen accused the people of resisting the Holy Spirit.

q: What did the believers in Jerusalem do?
a: The believers in Jerusalem became scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, thus spreading the faith to new areas.

q: What offer did Simon make to the apostles?
a: Simon offered the apostles money in exchange for the power to give the Holy Spirit by the laying on of hands.

q: What did Philip then do to the man?
a: Philip and the eunuch both went into the water and Philip baptized him.

q: What message about Jesus had the people in Cornelius’ house already heard?
a: The people had already heard that Jesus was anointed by the Holy Spirit and with power, and that he had healed all who were oppressed, for God was with him.

q: What evidence did Peter present to demonstrate that God had accepted the Gentiles?
a: Peter presented the fact that the Holy Spirit had come upon the Gentiles just as the Spirit had fallen upon the Jews in the beginning.

q: What did the Holy Spirit tell them to do?
a: The Holy Spirit told them to set apart Barnabas and Saul to do the work to which the Spirit was calling them.

q: What did the assembly do after hearing from the Holy Spirit?
a: The assembly fasted, prayed, laid hands on Barnabas and Saul, and sent them off.

q: How did God give evidence about the message of his grace?
a: God gave evidence about the message of his grace by granting signs and wonders to be done by the hands of Paul and Barnabas.

q: What did certain men from Judea come and teach the brothers?
a: Certain men from Judea taught that unless the brothers were circumcised, they could not be saved.

q: How did Peter say that both Jews and Gentiles are saved?
a: Peter said that both Jews and Gentiles are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus.

q: What question did the jailer ask Paul and Silas?
a: The jailer asked Paul and Silas, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

q: What answer did Paul and Silas give the jailer?
a: Paul and Silas answered, “Believe on the Lord Jesus, and you shall be saved, you and your house.”

q: For what has God set a certain day?
a: God has set a certain day when Jesus will judge the world in righteousness.

q: What teaching did Apollos understand accurately, and in what teaching did he need more instruction?
a: Apollos understood the things concerning Jesus accurately, but he knew only the baptism of John.

q: John’s baptism was a baptism of what?
a: John’s baptism was a baptism of repentance.

q: In what name did Paul then baptize the disciples from Ephesus?
a: Paul baptized them in the name of the Lord Jesus.

q: What special miracles did God do by the hands of Paul?
a: When handkerchiefs and aprons were taken from Paul, they healed the sick and drove out evil spirits.

q: About what was the Holy Spirit witnessing to Paul in every city as he traveled toward Jerusalem?
a: The Holy Spirit was witnessing to Paul that chains and sufferings awaited him.

q: What ministry had Paul received from the Lord Jesus?
a: Paul’s ministry was to bear witness to the gospel of the grace of God.

q: What did Ananias tell Paul to arise and do, and why?
a: Ananias told Paul to arise and be baptized to wash away his sins.

q: After many days, what hope was abandoned by the crew of the ship?
a: After many days, the crew abandoned any hope that they should be saved.
